name: notipet
description: Lets Codex alert you on your Windows desktop - a sound and a pop-up - when it needs a decision, is blocked, or finished a long task, and stop that alarm when it is over. Needs the notipet tray app.

interface.shortDescription: A sound and a pop-up when Codex needs you
interface.longDescription: A skill so Codex can alert you - and stop its own alarm - when it needs a decision, is blocked, or finished a long task. For alerts at every finished turn and every approval prompt, it can also set up notipet's Codex hooks with your consent (notipet install-hooks --codex --write). Windows only; install the notipet app from GitHub Releases first.
defaultPrompt: Alert me through notipet when this task is done
